10352: Eleven men bent under leather straps, and one boy in the middle who still lifts his head.

Jews Praying in the Synagogue on Yom Kippur

10365: Van Gogh said the reaper was death, yet almost smiling, in a sun flooding all with gold.

10367: Arches shrink toward a far door, perspective pulling you in, as one small man hurries off.

10371: Almond branches in blossom against blue sky, for a newborn nephew named Vincent after him.
10372: Head in hand, the doctor wears what Van Gogh called 'the heartbroken look of our time'.

10374: An empty dirt road under a grey sky: the road prisoners were marched down to Siberia.

10388: The one-eyed giant hides behind the hills, too shy to approach the nymph asleep below.

10391: Christ sits bound and blindfolded. One man swings a fist, another plays a flute and drum.
10392: Witches fly by night, seen through an age that feared them, desired them and hunted them.

10394: Dürer drew his own naked body as it was, no myth, no hero, and looks straight at us.
10395: Landscape with the Fall of Icarus

Landscape with the Fall of Icarus

The Battle of Alexander at Issus

10401: Mad Meg, in a man's armour and loaded with loot, marches into Hell's mouth to plunder it.

The Burial of the Count of Orgaz

10406: Christ prays alone in fear while his friends sleep below, tucked in a cloud like a cocoon.

10409: Christ rises calm as the guards tumble back, foreshortened so they seem to fall out at us.

10498: Painted inside Bethlem asylum, in detail so fine that each tiny figure is its own world.
10499: He let go of the tiller to pray, unaware his angel still watches from behind the clouds.

10520: A kept woman rises from her lover's lap. In the mirror behind them, a sunlit garden.
